The speaker mentions Amazon crossing his desk 18-20 years ago but admits he was too dense to figure it out and let it go, noting he doesn't pay a penalty for passing.

thesis: This episode argues that the speaker currently holds significant positions in memory (Micron) and AI/blockchain infrastructure (Nvidia), viewing them as essential 'taxes' on modern digital commerce. He contrasts these current holdings with past missed opportunities in companies like Amazon, Starbucks, and Chipotle, while also noting his neutral stance on luxury goods like Ferrari and Mao Tai despite their strong fundamentals.

claims.quote: And so, you know, I think I sold some Ferrari at 60 and 100 and maybe 130 and so on and all those prices I felt were pretty good. And in hindsight, you know, the unfortunate thing was I bought a Ferrari, but I bought it after I'd sold the stock.
